appDesc.message: Nook, your assistant on the Mac, in your browser: ask about the page you are on, and let Nook read and act in your tabs after you approve.

setupStep2.message: Go to Settings › Editor & browser › Nook in your browser and click Connect.

setupStep3.message: Come back here: the panel connects by itself.

siteRestricted.message: The browser keeps its own pages to itself; Nook cannot read or use them.

siteAllowed.message: Nook may read and work on this site when you ask, after you approve on your Mac.

siteBlocked.message: Off for this site: Nook will not read or touch it.

pausedNote.message: Paused: Nook does not read or act in this browser until you resume.

intro.message: Ask Nook about this page, or ask it to do something here. Nook asks you on your Mac before it clicks, types or opens anything.

onMacNote.message: Waiting for you in Nook on your Mac.

noBrain.message: Nook has no model yet. Choose one in Nook › Settings › Assistant.

errorGeneric.message: Nook could not answer. Is Nook running on your Mac?

presenceWorking.message: Nook is working in this tab
